item.content:encoded:
Let me see if I can guess what happened here…

169's friends came to visit. The Foundation tried to kill them and accidentally killed all cellular life on Earth too. 173 survived because it's not made of cells. It chilled out in the remains of its containment chamber for a millennium because there was no one looking at it and no necks around to snap, then tried to get out because all the blood had flaked off it and it wanted more blood. It failed and a bunch of stuff fell on it, so it gave up and waited until Earth was destroyed and it floated off into space.

Yes?
